**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **What the document has:** Section 16.1 gives only a systems-capability rep (A), a promise that *reports* substantially conform to customer bulletins/User Manuals (B), rights/authority reps (C–D) and Millennium compliance (E), all subject to the all-caps disclaimer at 16.1.F. Section 9.1 commits M&I to perform the Services to the Performance Standards for the whole term (satisfying the fallback services-duration element); the Service Level Credits at 9.2.D are redacted, and Sections 12.3/13 provide only termination and direct damages — no repair, replacement or refund.
- **Why it fails fallback:** a report-to-manual conformity promise is not a software-to-documentation warranty, there is no conformance period, and no warranty remedy exists anywhere.
- **Cure:** one insertion — new Section 16.1.G with a 90-day software conformance warranty plus repair/replacement or refund remedy. Because the disclaimer is drafted "EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1," the new subsection survives it without any edit to 16.1.F.
